author_implementation.title: Implementing Tests For Forecast Evaluation in the Presence of Instabilities

locators.printed_p3_note3: Models estimated using a fixed or rolling scheme with fixed estimation-sample size; recursive schemes excluded.
locators.printed_p4_section3.1_equation3: F_t,m equals the uncentered local loss-difference sum divided by sqrt(m) and global HAC long-run standard deviation; H0 equal expected loss at every forecast date.
locators.printed_p5_section3.2: Command requires realizations and forecasts; parameters and knowledge of generating models are unnecessary.

corroborating_author_review.author: Barbara Rossi
corroborating_author_review.title: Forecasting in the Presence of Instabilities

implementation_scope.bootstrap_variant: centered circular14,20000 replicates,globalBartlettHAC14 reestimated in each replicate
implementation_scope.null_assumptions: weak dependence and a suitable stable global long-run variance approximation under the null; not automatic robustness to arbitrary nonstationary heteroskedasticity
implementation_scope.loss_scope: daily mean of individual fixed-seed squared losses; not the benchmark mean individual-seed RMSE nor squared error of an ensemble

interpretation_guards: An EPA rejection can result from a constant nonzero loss difference and does not by itself demonstrate a temporal break.
A non-rejection is not evidence of equivalence, stationarity, absence of overfit, or calibration.
The test chronology was already known from E1; no new blind test was created.
Bootstrap critical values are an explicit posthoc calibration adaptation; the original table threshold is separate and unadjusted.
